info.name: Returns a list of packages available for a partner account.

items.docs: This endpoint returns a list of packages available for a partner account. The response will include the package slug and package name. (Packages are listed according to the authenticated credential)

info.name: Returns accounts and subsidiaries that are linked to the partner account. (If no query parameters are provided, all accounts and subsidiaries linked to the partner account will be returned.)

params.name: domains
params.description: Filter by List of Organizational Domain Names (org domains).

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by List of Account Names

params.name: slug
params.description: Filter by List of Account Slugs

params.name: parent-slug
params.description: Filter by List of Parent Account Slugs (Only valid for admin accounts)

params.name: reverse
params.description: Reverse the order of the list to be provided.

params.name: sort-key
params.description: Sorts the given list by a key. Allowed values: slug, name, parent_slug, enabled_org_domains_limit, blocked_org_domains_limit, sending_sub_domains_limit, approved_senders_limit.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to be accessed according to the division of items provided in conjunction with the 'per-page' parameter.

params.name: per-page
params.description: Number of accounts per page on the provided list.

items.docs: Returns accounts and subsidiaries that are linked to the partner account. (If no query parameters are provided, all accounts and subsidiaries linked to the partner account will be returned.)

info.name: Creates a new account with the partner account as the parent account and also creates all domains provided in the request body as enabled domains linked to the account that was created.

items.docs:
Optional:
- org-domain-name (the list of the domains that will be associated with the account)
- enabled-org-domains-limit (the limit of enabled domains)
- blocked-org-domains-limit (the limit of blocked domains)
- sending-sub-domains-limit (the limit of domains with sender services)
- approved-senders-limit (the limit of approved senders)
- package-slug (if it is not provided, the account will be created with the default package Valimail Core, subject to par

info.name: Returns a single account that are linked to the partner account according to the account slug provided.

items.docs: Returns a single account that are linked to the partner account according to the account slug provided.

info.name: Updates name, limits, and package of authorized accounts according to the slug provided in the path.

items.docs: Empty string values are treated as not provided. Numeric 0 values are treated as not provided. If approved-senders-limit is -1, the account stores a null approved sender limit and reads it back as -1. If package-slug is omitted, the existing package is preserved.

info.name: Deletes the account according to the account slug provided. Depending on the account's domains, either destroys the account or revokes it by removing its users and domains.

items.docs: Deletes the account according to the account slug provided. Depending on the account's domains, either destroys the account or revokes it by removing its users and domains.
